https://competitioncorner.net/api2/v1/ev.description:
See all the movement standards, scorecards and workouts by: Clicking on this link

Qualifier workout Beginners / Kids + Adults / Teens + Adults 

Part A: DUMBBELL MAYHEM - 6 Rounds 

YOU GO I GO (Athletes alternate each round)

12 double DB hang cleans 

9 double DB front squats 

6 double DB S2OH

Score part A: Time after the last S2OH:

Directly into 1:00 rest after finishing

Part B: MIDLINE BURNER - 7 min AMRAP

Athletes divide reps as wanted 

10 Knee raises 

20 Box step overs (50cm)

40 Single unders 

Score part B: Total number of rounds & reps: 

Directly into 1:00 rest after 7 minutes

Part C: ENGINE OVERLOAD - 4 Rounds 

15 cal assault bike // Parent/Kids: 16 alternating burpees over partner 

15 synchro Plate ground to overhead 

Score Part C: Total Time: Part A+B+C:

Weights:

Part A

Beginners 2X DB Male 10 KG / Female 7.5 KG

Kids 2X DB 3 KG 

Teens 2x DB 5 KG

Part C 

Beginners Plate Male 10 KG / Female 5 KG 

Teens Plate 5 KG 

Kids 2.5 KG 

* Adults use same weight as beginners 

There is only one set of Dumbbells used per weight 

Flow: 

PART A

Buddy

Use a running clock during the full workout. 

At the signal of 3-2-1 go: Athlete 1 starts and picks up the DB’s to perform 12 DB hang cleans, followed by 9 DB front squats and finish the round with 6 DB shoulder to overhead. 

When A1 is finished, he/she taps A2 and then A2 performs the same round.

Athletes keep alternating rounds until all 6 rounds are completed. 

Then go into 1 minute mandatory rest. 

Score for Part A is time as the last shoulder to overhead is completed. 

Triplets

A1: working, when he/she is finished he/she taps A2, when A2 is finished, he/she taps A3 and he/she performs the same full round.

Athletes keep alternating rounds until all 6 rounds are completed. 

Then go into 1 minute mandatory rest. 

Score for Part A is time as the last shoulder to overhead is completed. 

PART B

Buddy & Triplets

After that minute immediately starts with part B: 

One Athlete jumps in the rig and starts performing as many knee raises as possible. 

Athletes can switch as often as they want to complete all 10 reps.

going into 20 box step overs and 40 single unders. 

Athletes can keep switching to perform the total reps and keep going until the 7min are passed. 

Score for Part B is rounds en reps completed at the end of the 7 minutes. 

After they take a 1 minute mandatory rest. 

PART C

Buddy & Triplets

After that minute immediately starts with part C: 

Athlete 1 or 2 (or 3) starts biking for as many calories as possible they can switch as often as wanted to complete the total amount of 15 calories 

followed by 15 syncro plate ground to overhead.

They keep doing this until 4 rounds are finished.

Score Part C is total time of the workout. 

After the workout, show the screen with the total of calories in the video.

Adult & Kid

Athlete 1 or 2 starts performing 16 alternating burpees over partner.

When the 16 are completed start performing 15 syncro plate ground to overhead.

They keep doing this until 4 rounds are finished.

Score Part C is total time of the workout. 

 

Qualifier workout Regular / Advanced 

Part A: BARBELL MAYHEM - 6 Rounds 

YOU GO I GO (Athletes alternate each round ) 

12 Hang cleans 

9 Front squats 

6 Shoulder to overhead 

Score part A: Time after the last S2OH

 

Directly into 1:00 rest after finishing

 

Part B: MIDLINE BURNER - 7 min AMRAP 

10 single leg Toes To Bar (Regular) / Toes To Bar (Advanced) 

20 box jump overs (Regular 50cm / Advanced M 60cm / F 50cm)

60 SU (Regular) / 60 DU (Advanced)

Score part B: Total number of rounds & reps: 

 

Directly into 1:00 rest after 7 minutes

 

Part C: ENGINE OVERLOAD - 4 Rounds 

15 Call assault bike

15 Syncro american KB swings 

(weight kb F 12/16/20)

(weight kb M 16/20/24)

 

Score Part C: Total Time: Part A+B+C:

 

Weight:

Part A 

Regular Barbell Male 40 KG / Female 30 KG

Advanced Barbell Male 50 KG / Female 40 KG 

 

Part C 

Regular KB Male 20 KG / Female 16 KG 

Advanced KB Male 24 KG / Female 20 KG

 

Same sex use the same barbell

 

Flow: 

 

PART A 

Buddy

Use a running clock during the full workout. 

At the signal of 3-2-1 go: Athlete 1 starts and picks up the barbell to perform 12  hang power cleans, followed by 9 barbell front squats into 6 barbell shoulder to overhead. 

When A1 is finished, he/she taps A2 and then A2 performs the same round.

Athletes keep alternating rounds until all 6 rounds are completed. 

Then go into 1 minute mandatory rest. 

 

Score for Part A is time as the last shoulder to overhead is completed. 

 

Triplets

A1: working, when he/she is finished he/she taps A2, when A2 is finished, he/she taps A3 and he/she performs the same full round.

Athletes keep alternating rounds until all 6 rounds are completed. 

Then go into 1 minute mandatory rest. 

 

Score for Part A is time as the last shoulder to overhead is completed. 

 

PART B

Buddy & Triplets

After that minute immediately starts with part B: 

One Athlete jumps in the rig and starts performing as many (Single leg) Toes to bar as possible. 

Athletes can switch as often as they want to complete all 10 reps.

going into 20 box jump overs and 60 single/double unders. 

Athletes can keep switching to perform the total reps and keep going until the 7min are passed. 

Score is rounds en reps completed at the end of the 7 minutes. 

 

After they take a 1 minute mandatory rest. 

 

PART C

Buddy & Triplets

After that minute immediately starts with part C: 

Athlete 1 or 2 (or 3) starts biking for as many calories as possible they can switch as often as wanted to complete the total amount of 15 calories 

followed by 15 syncro american kettlebell swings.

They keep doing this until 4 rounds are finished.

Score is total time of the workout.

Flow:

Buddy

AMRAP – Max Meters (TC 15)
■ Max meters row
■ Every 2 minutes: 2 × 4m burpee broad jumps

Flow:


■ At the call of 3-2-1-GO, athletes go to the rower and begin accumulating as
many meters as possible.
■ At every 2-minute mark a signal will sound — athletes must stop rowing and
perform a 4m burpee broad jump out and 4m back.
■ Once the burpee broad jumps are completed, athletes return to the rower and
continue accumulating meters until the next 2-minute mark.
■ This sequence repeats until the 15-minute time cap is reached.

WOD 2 Triplets: “Overhead Fury”
AMRAP 15’


■ 8m sync plate overhead walking lunges (all)
■ 32 double DB shoulder to overhead (shared)
■ 16 sync pull-up variants (C2B / pull-ups / ring rows)*
■ 64 wall balls (shared)


*RX: Chest-to-bar / Advanced: Pull-ups / Regular + Scaled: Ring rows
Sync: 2 athletes working, while the 3rd holds (RX + Advanced: top ring row hold /
Regular: dead hang)

Weights:


■ RX: Plate 20/15 – DB 15/12.5 – WB 9/6
■ Advanced: Plate 15/10 – DB 12.5/10 – WB 9/6
■ Regular: Plate 10/5 – DB 10/7 – WB 6/4

Flow:


At the call of 3-2-1-GO, all athletes run to the plate, lift it overhead, and perform a
4m lunge out and 4m back in sync.
After completing the lunges, Athlete 1 continues to the dumbbells while Athletes 2
and 3 return to the starting mat.
Athlete 1 performs as many reps of double DB shoulder to overhead as possible.
Reps can be divided freely, but athletes may only switch on the starting mat.
When the 32 reps are complete, all athletes move to the rig:
■ RX: 2 athletes perform C2B. Advanced: 2 athletes perform Pull-ups, while the 3rd
athlete holds a top ring row hold. Reps only count if the hold is correct.
■ Regular: 2 athletes perform ring rows, while the 3rd athlete holds a dead hang.
Reps only count if the hold is correct.
When 16 reps are complete, Athlete 1 continues to wall balls while Athletes 2 and 3
return to the starting mat.
Athlete 1 performs as many reps as possible; reps may be divided, but switching is
only allowed on the starting mat.
After 64 wall balls are complete, one round is finished.


The team continues this sequence until the 15-minute time cap.

WOD 3 Individual: “Unbroken Oath”
For Time (TC 15’)


100 front squats*
*Every time the barbell is dropped, perform 10 Russian kettlebell swings
Weights:
■ RX: BB 60/40 – KB 32/24
■ Advanced: BB 50/35 – KB 24/16
■ Regular: BB 40/30 – KB 16/12
■ Scaled: BB 35/25 – KB 12/8


Flow:


At the call of 3-2-1-GO, athletes run to the barbell and begin performing front
squats. The barbell must be lifted from the floor either by a power clean or squat
clean; if a squat clean is completed to full extension, it counts as the first rep of the
front squats.
Athletes continue working until all 100 front squats are complete.
If the barbell is dropped at any time, the athlete must perform 10 Russian kettlebell
swings before resuming. Resting is only in the front rack position allowed.
When all 100 front squats are complete, athletes return to the starting mat to stop the time.

For Time (TC 15’)


120 front squats*
*Every drop = switch athletes
*Every switch = 10 sync Russian kettlebell swings (2 athletes)
*Front squats only count if one athlete is holding 2 KBs in a front rack hold


Weights:


■ RX: BB 60/40 – KB 32/24
■ Advanced: BB 50/35 – KB 24/16
■ Regular: BB 40/30 – KB 16/12

Flow:


At the call of 3-2-1-GO, Athlete 1 moves to the barbell, picks it up from the floor, and
begins front squats. The bar may be lifted by a power clean or squat clean; if a
squat clean is completed to full extension, it counts as the first front squat.
Meanwhile, Athlete 2 holds 2 kettlebells in the front rack position. The front squat
reps only count if the kettlebells are correctly held — in front of the shoulders, not
resting on top of them. Athlete 3 is resting on the starting mat.
At every barbell drop, the athletes must switch roles:
■ The new squatter moves to the barbell
■ The previous squatter rotates to the KB front rack hold
■ The athlete who was holding the KB gets rest
With every switch, 2 athletes must perform 10 synchronized Russian kettlebell swings
before resuming. Doesn’t matter if it's A1+A2 or A1+A3 or A2+A3 or .... It's up to you.
When all 120 front squats are completed, the team returns to the starting mat.
Time stops when all athletes are back on the mat.

Floater - WOD counter - Beam Battle (TC 3min) AMRAP
Individuals


Max rounds in 3min of:


■ 3 sandbag deadlifts
■ 2 sandbag squats
■ Sandbag over the beam
■ Athlete pass the beam any how
■ Sandbag over the beam
■ Athlete pass the beam any how


After every round the wod counter button must be pressed to mark the round
Weights:
Rx M50/F40 kg
Advanced M40/F30 kg
Regular M30/F20 kg
Scaled M20/F10 kg


Flow:


press start on the wod counter. At the sign of 3-2-1 GO, the athlete press start on
the wod counter and pick up the sandbag to perform 3 sandbag deadlifts followed
by 2 sandbag squats.
After that the athlete throws the sandbag over the beam.
The athlete goes to the other side any how (over or under the beam not from the
side).
There pick up the sandbag and throw it over again, and the athlete passes the
beam.
This is the end of round 1: the athlete presses the wod counter button to mark the
rep.
Keep doing this until the 3min mark is passed.
The final score is the amount of rounds that is on the wod counter device.
The sandbag movements don’t need to be unbroken.

Welcome at the Finals

Live event

The best athletes of each division after the online events will be invited to the live finals at April 3rd & 4th 2027 at Sportcentrum Valkenhuizen, Arnhem (NL). The number of athletes per division will be based on the total number of athletes in each division. More athletes = more finalists in that division.

*New* Compete together

Nationals Buddy

In 2026, we’re adding the Buddy Divisions to Season 10. This is a competition with 2-person teams. For the buddies, there are three divisions:
– Blue Division
– Red Division
– Black Division

Both buddies perform the individual Placement Workouts. Based on their score, they will be placed in one of the three divisions. All 4 online workouts need to be done together. These workouts are buddy variations of the Individual Online Season workouts. Buddy teams can consist of 1 Males + 1 Female, 2 Males or 2 Females.

The division for teenagers

12 – 17 years old

For the young athletes, there are two special Divisions: Teens & Youngsters Division. Are you 12-17 years old? Then you can get a Teens-ticket with permission of your parents.

These athletes will be placed into the Teens or Youngster division, based on their placement results.

Teens: dumbbell 10/5kg, single unders, knee raises
Youngsters: dumbbell 15/10kg, double unders, toes to bar

The division for masters

35+ years old

Since Season 8 we’re adding two Masters Categories:
– 35+ years old (Gold level)
– 45+ years old (Silver level)

You can register for these divisions by buying a Masters Ticket. You have to be the age of the age group on October 18th 2026. Just like in the Teens and Youngsters divisions, there will be 1 workout (no separate levels within the division). Masters choose for their division but also have to perform the Placement.

Masters 35+ will have the same workouts as Gold, Masters 45+ will have the same workouts as Silver. If these levels are too high for you, you can join in the regular divisions.
